route.authorization: live tenant membership and editor access to source project

Generation-Replay-Only.fingerprint: not included; request JSON and key remain identical

replay.existing_receipt: 202 and canonical original RunAccepted after current source/session/project authorization; mutable draft/backend admission is skipped
replay.missing_receipt_replay_only: GENERATION_REPLAY_PENDING/409, transaction rollback, no receipt/tasks/run admitted
replay.after_wait: live session, tenant role, source and project authorization repeated in same transaction; failure returns no receipt body

client.uncertain: preserve original key/body; replay-only when current generation unavailable; do not resave draft
client.accepted: read original run/output, never create another generation
client.transient_read_failure: keep journal, allow retry, no terminal acknowledgement
client.failed_or_cancelled: explicit acknowledgement rereads same run status before clearing accepted journal
client.completed_with_errors: read available derivative variants; no usable derivative permits acknowledgement only after repeated status/output read
client.storage_failure: keep recovery state; acknowledgement marker prevents old writers reviving cleared attempt
client.foreground_scope: abort/detach on background/source change; reload scoped journal; ignore late responses

abandonment.request: identical frozen GenerateRequest and original Idempotency-Key
abandonment.existing_accepted: 202 original RunAccepted; do not clear local attempt, persist receipt and resume output read
abandonment.absent_admission: 200 {status:abandoned,key:original-key}; atomic tombstone under same receipt lock, no run/task admission
abandonment.late_original_send: GENERATION_REQUEST_ABANDONED/409 for valid original request; invalid original requests may fail earlier validation, but cannot admit work
abandonment.retention: tombstone expires_at year9999, retained until tenant purge; do not reuse abandoned key
abandonment.live_authority: source/project authorization before and after wait; callback reauthorizes too
abandonment.validation: abandon does not require draft/runtime/GenerationParams to pass new-admission validation; canonical body/key plus live source authority required
abandonment.client_clear: only validated matching-key abandoned receipt permits clearAbandoned; accepted journal cannot be cleared by this path
abandonment.transport_or_malformed_response: preserve original journal/key, allow retry of resolution
abandonment.source_or_foreground_change: abort and ignore late response; preserve scoped journal
